description: A forceOrder message with o.ps = "5" (a string) and o.s = 5 (a number): `o` has a key s, so the reason is ps_ne_s, not ps_no_s, and an o.s that is not a string differs (7.5a). Compared as strings the two would be equal, so a reading that coerces o.s to a string reports nothing. The message is also MALFORMED in the replay (symbol): slot NONE, one void; ONE hard FORCE_MSG_STRUCTURE with the physical line number.
title: one ps_ne_s message whose o.s is not a string
